en.summary: This commit fixes WCTL mask generation for no-PID configurations by bypassing the latched per-packet accumulation path when there is no PID subdivision; it also contains a separate collector-selection fix for WCTL issue routing.
why_it_counts: It changes real DUT control logic in the warp-control execution path.
The selected fault mechanism affects split and predicate mask semantics, not only naming or cleanup.
The bug description is reusable on other SIMT control units that optionally collapse to a single packet or PID.
disqualifiers: The same commit includes minor rename-only edits in VX_fpu_unit.sv and VX_lsu_slice.sv.
evidence: VX_wctl_unit.sv adds a PID_BITS != 0 branch with latched accumulation and a separate PID_BITS == 0 branch that directly computes then_tmask and else_tmask.
Before the fix, then_tmask_n and else_tmask_n always reused latched state and indexed by execute_if.data.pid even when there was no PID subdivision.
VX_operands.sv also adds special collector selection for WCTL, but the WCTL unit hunk alone is already a concrete DUT control fix.

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: A SIMT warp-control unit may accumulate then and else thread masks across several PID fragments when one logical instruction is delivered in multiple packets. If the design is configured with no PID subdivision, that accumulation path must be bypassed and masks must be computed directly from the current packet. Reusing the accumulated state in single-packet mode leaks stale mask bits into the next predicate or split instruction.

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: single-packet predicate and split mask generation
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: A no-PID or single-packet configuration executes predication or split control instructions back to back.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Route the no-PID case back through the latched accumulation path instead of computing masks directly from the current packet.
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: reuse stale accumulated mask in single-packet mode
portability_notes: This applies to SIMT control logic that sometimes accumulates masks across packetized subgroups and sometimes executes in a collapsed one-packet mode.
The bug is easiest to expose when successive control instructions use different lane predicates or thread masks.
Only the mask-building logic needs to be corrupted; the downstream warp-control consumer can stay unchanged.
concrete_injection_steps: Locate the logic that builds then and else masks for predication or split instructions.
Identify whether the implementation has separate behavior for packetized mode versus no-PID or single-packet mode.
Remove the special direct-compute path for the no-PID case and send that configuration through the stateful accumulation logic instead.
Keep the final selection between then and else masks unchanged so stale state contaminates otherwise valid control flow.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: WCTL then and else thread-mask generation when PID_BITS is 0
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The fix splits VX_wctl_unit.sv into separate PID and no-PID branches, with the no-PID branch computing then_tmask and else_tmask directly instead of using the latched accumulation registers.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: In hw/rtl/core/VX_wctl_unit.sv, delete the PID_BITS == 0 special case and force no-PID configurations back through the latched accumulation logic.

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Predicate and split operations in no-PID configurations use stale or contaminated thread masks, activating the wrong threads or making the wrong path appear taken.
evidence_for_injection: The pre-fix code always updated then_tmask_n and else_tmask_n from retained state plus execute_if.data.pid indexing.
The fix adds a dedicated combinational no-PID branch, which is precisely the reversible semantic difference.
The chosen injection is grounded entirely in the real WCTL patch and does not rely on the unrelated rename-only hunks.
notes: A second real fix exists in VX_operands.sv for WCTL collector selection, but the no-PID WCTL mask bug is the cleaner cross-DUT injection target.
Because the commit bundles more than one fix, confidence is kept at medium.

zh.summary: 该提交修复了无 PID 配置下的 WCTL 掩码生成：当没有 PID 子分包时，应绕开带锁存的逐包累积路径，直接根据当前包计算掩码；同一提交里还包含另一处 WCTL 发射 collector 选择修复。
why_it_counts: 它修改了 warp-control 执行路径中的真实 DUT 控制逻辑。
这里选择的故障机制影响的是 split 和 pred 的掩码语义，而不仅仅是命名清理。
该错误描述可以迁移到其他可在单包或多 PID 模式间切换的 SIMT 控制单元。
disqualifiers: 同一提交在 VX_fpu_unit.sv 和 VX_lsu_slice.sv 中还包含了少量仅重命名的改动。
evidence: VX_wctl_unit.sv 新增 PID_BITS != 0 的累积分支，以及单独的 PID_BITS == 0 分支，用于直接计算 then_tmask 和 else_tmask。
修复前 then_tmask_n 和 else_tmask_n 总是复用锁存状态，并在没有 PID 细分时仍按 execute_if.data.pid 进行索引。
VX_operands.sv 也加入了 WCTL 的特殊 collector 选择，但仅 WCTL 单元中的这个 hunk 就已经是一个具体的 DUT 控制修复。

fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: SIMT warp-control 单元在一个逻辑指令会被拆成多个 PID 分包时，可能需要跨多个包累积 then 和 else 线程掩码。如果设计配置为没有 PID 细分，那么这条累积路径就必须被绕开，掩码应直接从当前包计算。若单包模式仍误用这条有状态的累积逻辑，就会把陈旧掩码泄漏到下一条 pred 或 split 控制指令里。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 单包 pred 和 split 掩码生成
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 无 PID 或单包配置下，连续执行 predication 或 split 控制指令时。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 让无 PID 场景重新走带锁存的累积路径，而不是直接根据当前包计算掩码。
portable_injection_spec.implementation_pattern: 在单包模式下复用陈旧累积掩码
portability_notes: 这适用于有时需要跨多个子包累积掩码、有时又会退化成单包模式的 SIMT 控制逻辑。
当连续控制指令使用不同的 lane predicate 或 thread mask 时，最容易暴露该错误。
只需破坏掩码构建逻辑；下游 warp-control 消费者可以保持不变。
concrete_injection_steps: 定位 pred 或 split 指令中构造 then 和 else 掩码的逻辑。
确认实现中是否区分了分包模式与无 PID 或单包模式。
删除无 PID 场景下的直接计算分支，让该配置重新走带状态的累积逻辑。
保持 then 与 else 掩码的最终选择逻辑不变，使陈旧状态污染原本有效的控制流。

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: PID_BITS 为 0 时的 WCTL then 和 else 线程掩码生成
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: 修复把 VX_wctl_unit.sv 拆成 PID 和无 PID 两条路径，其中无 PID 路径直接计算 then_tmask 和 else_tmask，而不再使用锁存的累积寄存器。
repository_grounding.mutation_strategy: 删除无 PID 的直接掩码路径
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: 在 hw/rtl/core/VX_wctl_unit.sv 中，删除 PID_BITS == 0 的特殊分支，让无 PID 配置重新走锁存累积逻辑。

fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: 无 PID 配置下的 pred 和 split 操作会使用陈旧或被污染的线程掩码，导致错误线程被激活，或错误路径被当成 taken。
evidence_for_injection: 修复前的代码总是基于保留状态和 execute_if.data.pid 索引去更新 then_tmask_n 与 else_tmask_n。
修复新增了专门的组合式无 PID 分支，这正是可逆的语义差异所在。
这里选择的注入点完全由真实的 WCTL 补丁支撑，不依赖其他仅重命名的 hunk。
notes: VX_operands.sv 中还有另一处真实的 WCTL collector 选择修复，但无 PID 的 WCTL 掩码错误更适合作为跨 DUT 的主注入目标。
由于该提交同时捆绑了多个修复，因此置信度保守设为 medium。
